messages:
Rina (CSM): Heads up — Helios Labs wants to change billing to quarterly for the first 6 months of their renewal and pay the initial invoice via wire. They also asked that seat true-ups happen monthly after go-live. Need finance/legal signoff and wording for amendment.
Vik (Sales): Customer says cash-flow team prefers quarterly to align with their project budget. Sales can accept if deposit or guarantee included. Any standard deposit %?
Tom (Revenue Ops): Typical approach: 25% deposit to cover the first quarter, remainder invoiced quarterly. Wire is fine; need bank details and invoice entity. We'll require a credit form for the quarterly cadence.
Dana (Customer PM): Confirming invoice entity is "Helios Labs Inc." and procurement will provide a PO. They may take 5 business days to issue PO after amendment.
Rina (CSM): Noted. If PO timing slips, can we provision on CC and reconcile once PO arrives? Ops?
Tom (Revenue Ops): We can provision with CC capture as fallback, but finance prefers wire or PO. We'll need explicit fallback language in the amendment.
Anika (Legal): I'll draft a one-page amendment: payment schedule table, deposit clause, PO and wire fallback, delegated signer block. Q: Do we need to change termination or renewal clocks?
Vik (Sales): No change to term length — still 12 months — just billing cadence for first 6 months. Customer insisted no term shortening.
Anika (Legal): Good. Also confirm signatory: they said Procurement Director can sign. Need written delegation.
Dana (Customer PM): Procurement Director name: Clara Ruiz, email clara.ruiz@helioslabs.com. She can sign for purchases under $150k — this renewal is $72k ARR.
Tom (Revenue Ops): Perfect. We'll include delegated signer clause that captures title and authority. Also request billing contact for remittance.
procurement-bot: Draft amendment uploaded: https://redwood.internal/agreements/helios-quarterly-amendment-v1.pdf
Rina (CSM): Thanks. Action list: Anika draft final amendment; Tom to provide wire instructions + deposit policy; Vik to confirm PO ETA; Dana to secure Clara's delegated signature email.
Tom (Revenue Ops): Wire details will be posted to the thread (sensitive info will be DM'd). Deposit policy: 25% upfront, rest quarterly. If credit check passes, deposit may be reduced to 10%. Credit check requested.
Anika (Legal): Draft posted for review. Two quick asks: include fallback to DocuSign signature flow, and explicit PO number space on the invoice.
Vik (Sales): I'll nudge procurement for PO and confirm GL code. ETA: they said by next Wed.
Dana (Customer PM): Procurement prefers DocuSign. I'll confirm and route internally.
Rina (CSM): Great. If PO arrives after first quarter starts, Tom is comfortable with backdated invoice reconciliation?
Tom (Revenue Ops): Yes — we'll invoice when service starts and credit once PO/invoice matches. Need PO by quarter-end for clean reconciliations.
procurement-bot: Preliminary invoice (draft) created: INV-HELIOS-2026-007 (link: https://redwood.internal/invoices/INV-HELIOS-2026-007).
Anika (Legal): Small language tweak suggested in clause 2.1 about deposit refunds; uploaded comment.
Rina (CSM): I'll incorporate and re-upload. Please mark as expedited — customer requested quick turnaround.
Vik (Sales): Also flag that enablement should be scoped to 60-min kickoff + one office hour if they accept the quarterly pilot. Marco from enablement is cc'd in the email.
Dana (Customer PM): Noted. I'll get Clara's signature routing preference and share PO when ready.
Tom (Revenue Ops): Credit check initiated. I'll update thread with status and wire details in DM.
Rina (CSM): Thanks everyone 10 planning to send amendment to customer once Anika finalizes. Low churn risk; main risk is procurement timing.
